title: Claude Code rate_limits Field for Statusline Scripts (v2.1.82)
description: New rate_limits field in statusline script data, providing 5-hour and 7-day usage windows with used_percentage and resets_at timestamps. Enables statusline scripts to display rate limit proximity warnings and prevent surprises during long automation runs. Particularly valuable for heartbeat cron jobs and iterative-improve loops that could hit rate limits mid-run.
notes: Native Claude Code feature (v2.1.82). Not in registry. High practical value for this workspace: heartbeat runs, iterative-improve loops, and openclaw-exchange all run autonomously and could hit rate limits. Adding rate limit awareness to statusline would provide early warning. The resets_at timestamp enables intelligent scheduling. Low integration complexity (statusline script update only).
